analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (1,053,000 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (1,118,400 KRW / 1,232,750 KRW / 1,446,860 KRW): Below short-term and mid-term moving averages, confirming a weak trend position.
· Position vs SMA100/200 (1,609,095 KRW / 1,532,522 KRW): Below long-term moving averages, maintaining strong long-term weakness.
· 52-week position (22.2%) + Current price is high relative to the 52-week low (501,000 KRW), but low relative to the 52-week high (2,987,000 KRW).
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (38.4 → 37.1): Entering oversold territory, maintaining downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-6177.9987 → -799.5230): Narrowing rate of decline, suggesting potential bottoming.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band 960,570 KRW): Approaching the lower band, exploring rebound potential.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (808,000 KRW): High relative to the 52-week low, acting as a psychological support.
· Swing Resistance (1,060,000 KRW): Located just above the current price, acting as short-term resistance.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (5-day low 1,044,000 KRW, 20-day low 1,044,000 KRW): Sideways pattern confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.45): Below the 5-day average, indicating low confidence in the movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): Considering the RSI's entry into oversold territory and the MACD histogram's improvement signal, a buy is considered below the 1,060,000 KRW swing resistance.
